sources.prompt:
Intent: generate (a new sprite sheet drawn to match existing reference art)
Asset type: three cut-out leg pieces for a 2D puppet rig of a cartoon European robin; the rig turns each piece about its own joint so the leg bends at the ankle when the bird crouches instead of squashing. Each piece must be separate, straight and unposed.
Primary request: split the robin's foreground leg into its three bones' pieces: (1) the lower end of the drumstick (the feathered tibiotarsus), (2) the bare tarsus (tarsometatarsus), (3) the foot (toes). Today the leg is one picture: design-docs/christmas/animation/parts-prototype/sources/leg-near.png (a feathered top, a long bare shin, the toes).
Output path: design-docs/christmas/animation/parts-prototype/sources/robin-legs-sheet.png
Input images (in this order):
  1. design-docs/christmas/animation/parts-prototype/assembled.png: the robin itself, standing (style, palette, how small and slim its legs are against its body).
  2. design-docs/christmas/animation/parts-prototype/sources/leg-near.png: its current foreground leg, one picture. Match it exactly: the same warm painterly cartoon style, the warm tan-brown leg colour with soft shading and fine scale marks, the thin dark brown outline, the dark grey curved claws, and the same slim proportions.
  3. design-docs/christmas/animation/parts-prototype/sources/leg-far.png: its background leg, for the same style.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat, uniform pure magenta #FF00FF background over the whole canvas, no gradient, no texture, no shadow, no vignette.
Subject, three pieces side by side in one row, left to right, each with a wide empty magenta gap around it (at least a sixth of the canvas width between pieces), nothing touching the edges, all at the same scale as each other and as leg-near.png's leg:
  1. Drumstick end (feathered tibiotarsus): a short upright patch of soft fluffy feathers, the leg's "trousers", standing vertically, as long as about a third of the bare shin in leg-near.png; wider and softly ragged at its top (that edge has NO outline: it is hidden under the belly), tapering at its bottom to a rounded end exactly as wide as the bare shin, where the bare leg starts. Warm buff and tan-brown feathers like the feathered top of leg-near.png. No bare leg, no toes.
  2. Tarsus (bare shin): one straight slim bare leg bone standing exactly vertical, about as long as the bare shin in leg-near.png from its feathers to where the toes begin, and as slim; a slightly thicker rounded knob at its top (the ankle joint) and a neatly rounded bottom end; warm tan-brown with soft shading and faint scale rings, thin dark brown outline all round. No feathers, no toes, no claws.
  3. Foot (toes alone), side view, facing right, standing flat as if on a branch: three slender forward toes spreading to the right and one short rear toe to the left, each with a tiny dark grey curved claw, all joined at a small rounded pad at the top of the foot where the shin would come down (leave that pad rounded and complete; no shin rising from it). Same toes as leg-near.png's, laid flat.
Style/medium: exactly the reference's painterly cartoon illustration: warm colours, soft shading, thin dark brown outlines, fine feather and scale detail.
Composition/framing: wide landscape canvas, about 3:1; the three pieces drawn large and vertically centred.
Text (verbatim): "none"
Transparency: yes, built-in chroma-key workflow acceptable (the magenta background is keyed out later; do not remove it yourself)
Constraints: each piece a single closed shape; straight, unposed; side view; palette identical to the reference leg.
Avoid: pink, purple or magenta anywhere in the art; a whole leg; a bent leg; extra toes or legs; shadows on the background; labels; text; perspective.

sources.note: An edit of round 1 recolouring only, to leg-near.png's muted warm brown. legs.py cuts it into leg-near-* and leg-far-* (the far a shade darker), each turned to its bone.
